objective: Enable one bounded live DR24 HATS payload probe from an isolated research-branch push, without requiring a browser session or changing the default-branch workflow behavior.
previous_knowledge_consumed: The existing DR24 payload probe workflow supports workflow_dispatch and a hard maximum of five OIDs.
The probe uses the indexed objectid field and preserves raw payload values.
A prior independent DR24 source-backed run retrieved four OIDs and 626 epochs with matching payload hashes.
The current GitHub connector can update branches and create pull requests but does not expose a workflow_dispatch action.
A branch-scoped push trigger can provide a reproducible, authorized alternative to a manual UI dispatch.

baseline.description: A one-branch workflow trigger extension. The push trigger is restricted to research/dr24-live-payload-probe-20261105. Existing workflow_dispatch remains available. No runtime, model, feature, taxonomy, benchmark, or scientific threshold changes.

correctness.before: The registered probe workflow required workflow_dispatch for live retrieval.
correctness.after: A push trigger restricted to one named research branch starts the same bounded probe. The default OID list is explicit and remains limited to three IDs.

reproducibility.before: A live rerun depended on a manual workflow dispatch.
reproducibility.after: A commit to the isolated branch starts a traceable workflow run and uploads the bounded payload artifact.

scientific_validity.reason: The workflow retrieves raw payloads only. It does not test astrophysical identity, feature compatibility, model inference, calibration, or anomaly performance.

reliability.reason: The new source-backed run is still pending final artifact inspection.

measurement.trade_off: Use a branch-specific trigger to avoid manual UI access. Keep the trigger limited to the exact research branch and retain contents: read permissions.

evidence: Created isolated branch research/dr24-live-payload-probe-20261105 from main.
Added a push trigger limited to that branch and three explicit OIDs.
Preserved the existing workflow_dispatch input and the hard maximum of five OIDs.
The deterministic payload contract-tests job passed in workflow run 42061697065.
The source-backed payload-probe job completed successfully in workflow run 42061697065; artifact inspection is pending.

root_causes: No branch-scoped push trigger existed for this bounded probe workflow.
unresolved: The source-backed run artifact must be inspected and its hashes compared with the prior four-OID reference artifact.
The application API endpoint and Workbench UI remain outside this workflow's scope.

findings: A narrowly scoped push trigger can run the existing source probe without manual workflow dispatch.
A workflow run is not evidence of successful retrieval until its job, artifact, schema, hashes, and object counts are inspected.
Keep the source probe separate from application integration and scientific validation.

open_blockers: Inspect the current run's source-backed artifact.
Verify the current PR CI and lifecycle gates.
Do not merge the workflow change unless the isolated trigger and all checks pass.

knowledge_carried_forward: Keep the push trigger restricted to the exact research branch.
Do not increase the OID cap or broaden the retrieval scope.
Keep raw values and provenance unchanged.
Do not claim API/UI integration or scientific validation from this probe.
